items.title: Harold Ousley interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: Johnny Griffin used to play down to one of the clubs, The Flame they called it. And the bandstand was so small. They had a little board across the bar. And we’d be leaning over the bandstand.

ctx.x: But it was wonderful. Because you know you’d run into — it would be similar to like here. You never know who you’re going to run into. And Johnny Griffin used to play down to one of the clubs, The Flame they called it. And the bandstand was so small. They had a little board across the bar. And we’d be leaning over the bandstand. You know but everybody had a great time.
That’s funny. I guess that was a good training ground too for young musicians.
